item.title: Watch highlights from the 2026 Grammy Awards in under 4 minutes
item.description: Watch highlights from the 68th Grammy Awards, hosted by comedian Trevor Noah in his sixth and final year. Kendrick Lamar set a new record as the most-awarded hip-hop artist in Grammy history. Several artists, including Bad Bunny, Billie Eilish, and Olivia Dean, addressed the U.S. political climate, focusing on ICE and immigration.

item.title: Rep. Ro Khanna says he's a 'firm no' on reopening the government because of ICE
item.description: Rep. Ro Khanna called on his fellow House Democrats to vote against a measure that would reopen parts of the federal government on Monday, saying that a vote in favor of it would support tactics of Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents.

item.title: AI-altered photos and videos of Minneapolis shootings blur reality

item.title: 5-year-old boy and father return to Minnesota after release from immigration custody
